# net

`node:http`-shaped server for the SEVM stack, built on the `mochinode_net`
engine plugin (`mochi_modules/mochinode_net.dll`).

## Usage

```js
import { createServer } from './node_modules/net/index.js';

const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    res.status(200).json({ ok: true, url: req.url });
});
server.listen(8080, () => console.log('listening on 8080'));
```

## Request object

- `method`, `url`, `path` (URL without query), `query` (parsed object)
- `headers` (lower-cased names), `body` (string)

## Response object

- `res.status(code)`, `res.setHeader(k, v)`, `res.writeHead(code, headers)`
- `res.json(obj)`, `res.send(body)`, `res.end(body?, contentType?)`

## Model

Blocking, single-threaded: one request is served at a time, driven from a JS
loop over `httpAccept()`. This keeps the engine's GC and atom table
single-owner — no cross-thread callbacks into the VM.
